tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The identity orange. Large fills, the primary chart series, elevation profiles, display text 24px+ and icons. Only 3.4:1 on white, so never small text on light grounds (use accent-text) and never white body text on it (use action for buttons).

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet orange ground: selected rows, highlighted table cells, callouts. Text on it: ink or accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange for links, small labels and inline emphasis on surface-000, surface-100 and brand-tint (4.8:1+ light, 6.5:1+ dark). Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of primary buttons and other controls that carry text. A deeper orange in light so white labels pass 4.8:1; pure brand in dark.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action and brand fills (4.8:1 light, 5.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Cards, report pages, plot backgrounds, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: App and website page background.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Wells, table header rows, hover state on surface-000.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Asphalt: the one dark block per page (footer, report cover band). Text on it: ink-inverse.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and stat numbers on every surface (13:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: stat labels, captions, axis tick labels, metadata, on surface-000, surface-100 and surface-200 (4.8:1+).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and card edges. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders, axis baselines (3:1+ on surfaces).

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Horizontal gridlines in plots. Never vertical gridlines unless reading exact x values matters.

tokens.name: chart-area
tokens.usage: Fill under an elevation or altitude line (brand at low alpha).

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Primary series: altitude, elevation, the climb itself. Always the series the plot is about.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Glacier blue. Second series: temperature, planned vs actual, comparison route. Pairs with orange without relying on red/green.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Granite. Third series or the reference line (previous attempt, guidebook time, average).

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series only, e.g. heart rate or SpO2. Do not pair with danger red.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series only, e.g. wind or sun hours. More than five series: split the plot.

tokens.name: seq-100
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, lowest step: heatmaps, altitude bands, choropleths.

tokens.name: seq-200
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, step 2.

tokens.name: seq-300
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, step 3.

tokens.name: seq-400
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, step 4.

tokens.name: seq-500
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, highest step (summit zone).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Summited, completed, conditions good. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Marginal conditions, turnaround-time approaching. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Turned back, avalanche risk 3+, errors. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: flag-yellow
tokens.usage: Lithuanian tricolour, from the membership card. Only as the three-band strip; never text or a chart series.

tokens.name: flag-green
tokens.usage: Lithuanian tricolour, middle band. Strip only.

tokens.name: flag-red
tokens.usage: Lithuanian tricolour, bottom band. Strip only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Report cover title, website hero. One per page.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Report chapter titles, app screen titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headings, card titles, plot titles.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Sub-sections, route names under a title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Left Couvercle hut at 01:30 under a clear sky.
styles.usage: Report narrative and all running text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Stat labels, eyebrow text, table headers. Set in uppercase.

styles.name: stat-xl
styles.usage: Headline stats in StatGroup. Tabular figures.

styles.name: tick
styles.usage: Axis tick labels and data labels in plots.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between a stat label and its number.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding x1.5, table cell padding, stripe pitch.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between stats.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between report sections and plot blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom margins, hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, table highlights, chart bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards. The system is sharp; do not go rounder.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Grade badges and filter chips only.

shadow.note: Flat system: hierarchy comes from surfaces and lines. One shadow for floating layers only.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips and the plot hover card. Never on cards in flow.
